summary: Backend-only validation completed for operator password reset and local forgot/reset flows. No Railway login or remote data modification performed.
action_items: Deploy latest backend revision to Railway so /api/auth/password/forgot and /api/auth/password/reset are published in live OpenAPI.
Optionally strengthen --dry-run in backend/scripts/reset_user_password.py to run full eligibility checks (disabled user / inactive tenant) before printing 'modifiable'.
critical_code_review_comments: reset_user_password.py uses security.password_hash (same backend hasher), rejects 0/multiple matches, rejects disabled account, validates active tenant, revokes refresh tokens, clears auth_attempts/password_resets, and verifies resulting hash.
No password or hash is printed/audited: console output is aggregate-only and audit details are limited to {'source': 'railway_terminal'}.
MONGO_URL and DB_NAME are sourced from environment and required at runtime; no hardcoded DB credentials detected.
Local auth recovery tests are MOCKED for infrastructure dependencies (mongomock DB, mocked email capture, mocked object storage), not production integrations.
seed_data_creation: Test-only local documents via pytest fixtures in mongomock; no remote or Railway data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suites executed separately due fixture incompatibility: /app/backend/tests/test_operator_password_reset.py and /app/backend/tests_local/test_api_local.py. Both passed. Live Railway API still requires deployment sync for forgot/reset route visibility.
rca_of_issue: Production symptom (401 login + 404 forgot) aligns with deployment drift: local code includes forgot/reset routes and tests pass, but live Railway OpenAPI lacks those routes, indicating backend revision not yet deployed.
